name: Maulhead Covenant
description: Wait with the head resting at one hip and the haft across the body ready for the first of the pair.

name: Sledgebanner
description: Drop the head from overhead as the first stroke and leave the second already half formed.

name: Heavyhelve Voyage
description: Land both feet in matched time with the head so stroke and step arrive as one.

name: Haemalmallet
description: Follow every landed stroke with a second at once while qi stays gathered in the forearms.

name: Undefiled Wedgeface
description: Turn the haft twice in the hands to throw a double attack off to either side.

name: Beetletroth
description: Catch a weapon between the head and haft and burst qi so the grip is torn open.

name: Vigor Mallethead
description: Bring two heavy falls onto one guard in quick pair until the guard and the arm behind it give way.

name: Unrivaled Flatten
description: Hit the ground once and let the echo of a second shock run through it after the first.

name: Matchless Gripbulge
description: Land the matched strokes in the same instant with qi poured into both so the target is crushed between them.

name: Famed Haemal Thud
description: The school's closing stroke in which the second fall of the pair settles the exchange and ends it.

name: Statute Sledgeface
description: Sink low with the head grounded before the shins and the haft slanted over the chest.

name: Steelquake
description: Carry the head from the highest point of the arc to the lowest in one unbroken fall.

name: Vigorendcap
description: Move in slow wading steps with the knees bent and the maul carried at the waist.

name: Steelmallet
description: Hammer blow upon blow around the opponent until the whole space seems filled with falling iron.

name: Squall Ironband
description: Tilt the haft so that a heavy cut spills over its length and runs off to the side.

name: Pealquake
description: Pin the opponent's weapon arm against the side of the basin with the haft and lean with qi.

name: Vigor Quake
description: Let an enemy cut pass the shoulder and drop the head like a sinking stone on the attacker's back.

name: Bedrock Pommelweight
description: Drive the head down so hard that the target is pressed into the floor like a stone in a basin bed.

name: Beetlecrown
description: Smash the head into the ground so that the floor trembles and lurches around the whole basin.

name: Illustrious Sledge
description: Bring the head down with a qi field that cracks the basin floor beneath the target.

name: Magnificent Endcap Decree
description: The school's closing stroke that fills the basin with a single fall and leaves no room to move.

name: Statute Maulbutt
description: Hold the haft along the curve of the body like a bank turning the current aside.

name: Thunderclap Sledgeface
description: Fall onto the target in one steady stroke like a bank slumping into a river.

name: Haemal Pulverize
description: Sweep the head around the edge of the opponent's stance like a slow eddy at the margin of a pool.

name: Dunequake
description: Step in a long curve around the guard so that the final stride ends at its flank.

name: Inferno Quake
description: Follow each stroke into the next along a curve with qi flowing steady in both arms.

name: Unbending Thud
description: Hook the haft behind an ankle and drag the leg out as an undertow drags a wader.

name: Heavyhelve Troth
description: Wind the haft in a slow loop that carries a thrust around the body and leaves it harmless.

name: Famed Gripbulge
description: Hammer the front foot where the ground is soft so that the stance gives way like a cut bank.

name: Steel Flatten
description: Come round the bend of the body with the head and drop it from the unguarded side.

name: Dunedolly
description: Slam the head down so that a swell of force rolls outward like a spring flood.

name: Squall Endcap
description: Break the curve of the opponent's whole stance with one fall of the head and a charged qi field.

name: Peerless Haemal Mallethead
description: The school's closing stroke that carries the head round the bend and onto the mark from behind.

name: Dollyvow
description: Stand watching the opponent with the head raised and the haft held ready across the body.

name: Bedrock Maulbutt
description: Let the maul fall from above so quickly that its shadow and its blow arrive together.

name: Spectral Maulhead
description: Hop from foot to foot as if crossing stones in a ford while keeping the head steady.

name: Steel Pulverize
description: Beat down twice and lift twice like wings with qi held in the shoulders through the rhythm.

name: Squallmallet
description: Sweep the haft across the front of the body to clear a crossing thrust.

name: Peremptory Sledge
description: Pin a weapon down beneath the head like prey under a talon and wrest it free with qi.

name: Steel Pommelweight
description: Spring high above the crossing and bring the maul down on the first to wade across.

name: Duneendcap
description: Slam the head into the ford bed so the stones jump and the crossing breaks up.

name: Malletcrown
description: Stoop on the crossing with a charged field of qi so the whole weight lands on one chosen man.

name: Squash Crown
description: The school's closing stroke in which the hawk chooses the crossing and the maul falls once on it.

name: Sainted Wedgeface
description: Hold the maul high and the haft out front as if perched above a drop.

name: Sovereign Ironband
description: Plunge the head down from the top of the lift as a hawk falls on a mark.

name: Gliding Maulhead
description: Glide in a long low step toward the mark with the head trailing lightly behind.

name: Vaunted Pommelweight
description: Rain repeated plunges on the same mark while qi stays level through the arms and back.

name: Heavyhelve Seal
description: Beat the flat of the head against a thrust like a pinion feather turning the wind.

name: Quenched Squash
description: Drive the capped butt forward like a beak into a gap in the plate.

name: Entropy Sledgeface
description: Spread the arms wide and clamp the head and haft over a weapon to hold it fast.

name: Squall Thud
description: Come down from the highest point of a leap with the whole of the maul's weight.

name: Maulbutt Edict
description: Land from a great height with the head leading and burst the ground outward on impact.

name: Haemal Endcap
description: Gather the whole field of qi into the maul and fall as a hawk upon its prey.

name: Fearless Pulverize Decree
description: The school's closing stroke that turns the field of qi into one hawk-like plunge of the head.

name: Prismendcap
description: Seat the weight low at the core and hold the haft level so the guard is rooted.

name: Thudverdict
description: Bring the head over in an arc that gathers like a basin and runs down like a river.

name: Skyborne Ironband
description: Turn the whole body about the core in a tight pivot with the head carried close.

name: Vacuumendcap
description: Send the haft butt in two thrusts along twin lines like two currents side by side.

name: Squall Quake
description: Chain falls of the head with a steady stream of qi drawn from the formed core.

name: Pallbeetle
description: Turn a cut around the haft with a surge of core qi like a river turning round a rock.

name: Thunderclap Mallethead
description: Press the head down on a weapon until the weight of the core crushes its edge flat.

name: Matchless Flatten
description: Turn aside a cut and fall twice upon the attacker with core qi doubling the second blow.

name: Imperial Sledge
description: Let the whole weight of the formed core fall through the arms and into the head.

name: Bedrock Wedgeface
description: Strike the floor so the shock gathers like a basin and then runs outward like a river.

name: Bedrock Gripbulge
description: Charge the maul with the qi of the core and bring it down so that target and ground both break.

name: Vigormallet
description: The school's closing stroke in which basin and river join in the head and fall as one.

name: Heavyhelve Vow
description: Stand square to the wind with the haft held low and the head grounded at the side.

name: Inferno Squash
description: Bring the sworn head over in a slow heavy arc and let it fall where the oath points.

name: Fleet Flatten
description: Plant each foot windward of the last so the gale presses the body into the ground.

name: Endcapcrown
description: Hammer in a long chain with each fall timed to a gust and qi held in the wrists.

name: Squall Wedgeface
description: Swing the sworn haft across the body so a cut is carried off on the wind.

name: Peal Maulhead
description: Tie the opponent's weapon against the haft in a quick knot of motion and wrench it away.

name: Steel Sledgeface
description: Ride a gust past an attack and bring the head down on the attacker's blind flank.

name: Inferno Mallethead
description: Bring the maul down with the cold wind of the high ground and a full charge of qi behind it.

name: Quaking Gripbulge
description: Hit the bare rock so the shock leaps through it and unseats everyone standing on that ground.

name: Vigordolly
description: Swear the whole field of qi to the head and let it fall once with the wind behind it.

name: Bedrock Quake
description: The school's closing stroke in which the sworn head falls once along the oath and the wind.

name: Ironband Pledge
description: Point the haft along the sworn bearing and hold it there while cuts break against it.

name: Valiant Squash
description: Drop the head along the sworn line without letting it drift a finger's breadth.

name: Wraithlike Pulverize
description: Hold the heading with each step so that the feet never leave the line of the oath.

name: Matchless Sledge
description: String strokes along one heading in an even chain with qi steady in both forearms.

name: Inviolate Maulbutt
description: Hold the haft on the heading and let a thrust slide off to either side of it.

name: Pealmallet
description: Pry the opponent's weapon off its heading with the haft so their next stroke goes astray.

name: Thunderclap Thud
description: Drive the head down the bearing with all qi gathered until the guard in its path breaks.

name: Toppling Maulbutt
description: Hit the ground on the oath line so that the shock follows it and topples what stands on it.

name: Vigorsledge
description: Spend the full field of qi on a single fall that keeps the bearing to its very end.

name: Vaunted Bedrock Sledgeface
description: The school's closing stroke that keeps the bearing unbroken until the head lands on the sworn mark.

name: Revered Pommelweight
description: Hold the haft before the body as at the opening of the rite with the head grounded at the rim.

name: Heroic Squash
description: Bring the head over with the gale at the back and let it fall as the rite requires.

name: Vigor Flatten
description: Place each foot close along the lip of the drop so the stance is never overextended.

name: Intrepid Pulverize
description: Jab the haft butt forward at the close of each turn of the rite.

name: Sovereign Pommelweight
description: Run the rite's cycle of falls in order with qi unbroken from the first to the last.

name: Pallmallet
description: Meet a cut with the head turned to the wind so that the gust adds to the deflection.

name: Entropy Gripbulge
description: Bind a weapon to the haft in the turn of the rite and pry it out of the hand.

name: Haemal Ironband
description: Step toward the rim as a cut comes and drop the head on the exposed back of the attacker.

name: Thunderclap Wedgeface
description: Come down on the target at the rim with the full weight of the gale and a charge of qi.

name: Intrepid Quake
description: Slam the head near the rim so that the lip shakes and the footing crumbles.

name: Steel Thud
description: Perform the great rite in a single fall of the head with a full field of qi behind it.

name: Steel Heavyhelve
description: The school's closing stroke of the rite in which the gale and the maul fall together at the rim.

name: Sainted Maulhead
description: Turn the haft with each shift of the wind so the guard always faces the cut.

name: Wedgeface Decree
description: Time the fall of the head to the instant a gust swings round and add its push.

name: Evanescent Heavyhelve
description: Veer off the line of attack with a short angled step that the wind seems to carry.

name: Inferno Flatten
description: Shift the line of each fall with the wind and keep qi flowing evenly between strokes.

name: Undaunted Endcap
description: Veer the body and sweep the haft across in one motion so the thrust finds only air.

name: Venom Endcap
description: Rap the opponent's weapon sharply as the wind shifts so their bearing is lost for a breath.

name: Noble Pommelweight
description: Wait for the gust to reverse and strike back along it before the opponent sets his feet.

name: Squall Sledgeface
description: Drop the maul at the instant the wind turns with all the qi gathered for that one moment.

name: Bedrock Mallethead
description: Slam the head into the ground as the wind turns so the shock spins outward in a ring.

name: Quenched Thud
description: Hold the field of qi until the wind turns and then let the maul fall with all its weight.

name: Magnificent Sledge
description: The school's closing stroke that waits for the wind to turn and lands with it.

name: Warding Maulbutt
description: Hold the haft low and steady like a man carrying a great weight that he will not set down.

name: Haemal Maulhead
description: Hold the head aloft a breath longer than seems wise and then let all its weight fall.

name: Bedrock Ironband
description: Step slowly under the maul's burden so that each foot lands without a wobble.

name: Steelendcap
description: Let heavy strokes follow one another slowly with qi sunk deep in the belly between them.

name: Parity Endcap
description: Swing the heavy haft across so the weight alone bats a light cut out of the way.

name: Peal Mallethead
description: Set the head on an enemy weapon and lean the whole burden on it until the blade bends.

name: Haemal Sledge
description: Bring the held weight down in one slow certain fall with qi packed into the head.

name: Majestic Thud
description: Let the full burden drop onto the ground so the earth groans and heaves outward.

name: Squashedict
description: Release the whole burden of the oath as a single fall with a field of qi packed behind it.

name: Thudcrown
description: The school's closing stroke in which the carried oath is set down at last on the target.

name: Dollytroth
description: Root the stance at the core in the open and hold the haft out as the only cover.

name: Vigorthud
description: Bring the head over with the open gale at the back and nothing to check the blow.

name: Vigor Gripbulge
description: Stride across open ground with the weight carried at the core and the head riding easy.

name: Prismmallet
description: Drive the haft butt straight along the bearing with the whole core behind the thrust.

name: Squallbeetle
description: Chain strokes across open ground with a steady stream of qi drawn from the formed core.

name: Deluge Wedgeface
description: Open the stance and turn the haft with core qi so that a thrust is thrown wide.

name: Venomthud
description: Press the haft against a weapon and wrench it free with a surge of core qi.

name: Vigorsquash
description: Let a cut go by on the gale and drop the head on the attacker with core qi behind it.

name: Lordly Mallethead
description: Come down on the target in the open with the whole weight of the core in the head.

name: Tempestuous Maulhead
description: Split the open ground with one blow so that the gale howls through the opened cracks.

name: Squash Decree
description: Pour the core and the gale into the maul and bring it down so that target and ground break.

name: Fearless Quake Banner
description: The school's closing stroke that lets the open gale itself fall through the head of the maul.
